description: Ministry of Defence - The Prashasaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya and the Prashasaneeya Seva Padakkama
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the awarding of military honors (Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya and Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama) to naval personnel. This falls under public service recognition and awards, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with service honors and recognition within the public sector, specifically for military personnel. The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with portfolios, land matters, legal regulations, commercial activities, elections, or judicial appointments.
